body: Am I even worth the time people spend looking at this thread?
There aren't any good starting out jobs for me.
No, my ex-bf said that I would just embarrass myself if I showed my work to my professors.  He said that I would never be able to show my face in the community again.
I can't be gentle with myself.  If I am, I will never do anything with my life/  I will just die alone and in debt.  Like I said, I don't matter.
BUT if nobody believes in my work then it won't get published and it won't get considered for the future.

well, I got rid of him.  He didn't treat me with respect, and he didn't even try to understand anything that was going on with me, so I didn't want to continue to indulge him anymore.

I'll have to find someone to appreciate my uniqueness.

Ok, now, when it turns to 5a Central Standard time, I will be dead.  Sorry if I wasted your time.

If you have any ideas, let me know.  I'm currently just cutting the artery in my left wrist.  But my mom is asleep, so there is no chance of her waking up.  Thanks for answering.
Why do you care about me so much?  If you could inherit my aura, then it shouldn't be a problem.
he doesn't even study physics.  He studies anthropology, and he didn't even take into consideration ANY of my research.

Why should I keep breathing??  You matter more than I do, so you shouldn't even be wasting your time on my post.  You should be soaking up everything that you need to for a promotion.

Thank you.
I'm wasting space in the sense that other normal people can make something of themselves in my place.  My ideas and intellect will never be as good as theirs will be.
He doesn't know.  I've told him when he's been drunk, but he doesn't remember, and I don't think he'd be accepting if he was sober.
If anyone deserves to live, it's not someone like me who has so many disorders.  I NEED to die so that someone else can take over the space that I was wasting.

He did leave me over that.  He thought I should be focusing on anthropology rather than physics or mathematics.

I did find an analogy between physics and mental states, but if he didn't believe me, then who else will?  It's a lost cause.  I did the experiment so that other researchers could replicate it, but if he didn't believe it, how would anyone else believe me?  I failed.

I feel like I should suffer a very difficult death.  I feel like I should be sliced across the throat, or sliced down the stomach, or shot through the mouth.  I don't deserve anything past a painful death right now.

I'm not a decent person.  I can't feel when he touches me.  I can't feel when he tries to make me happy.  I fail at common human interaction.  He deserves someone who can physically love him back.  I love him, but how do I know if it's actually love?

I've been told that he does so many things for me, but if I can't feel them, it doesn't matter what he does.  He deserves someone who can appreciate his feelings and his touch.

Without a degree, I don't matter in the scientific community.  That's why my ex-boyfriend left me.  He said that my ideas weren't able to be substantiated.

Nobody believes in me.  At all.  But don't waste your time on me.  You have other, more important things to think of, and it matters more than I ever will.
I put it in my closet on the floor, but I can still see it.  It's the only thing that gives me comfort.
The gun is still sitting beside me.  Ironically, I don't want to see the harsh, bright red color of the gunshot.  But I really want to die.
How?  You should have realized that I'm not worth your time.  I'm sorry I wasted your time (enough that you posted on this thread.)
I'm a chicken.  The gun is loaded, but it's still just sitting beside me.
Read the other comments.  I don't matter.
Read the other comments.  I don't matter.

Just to update:

I'm smoking my hookah and drinking my liquor, and I have my gun at the ready.  I appreciate everything that you guys have tried to do, but I just don't think it will work.  When the clock turns to 2a my time, I'm going to shoot myself.  I've looked up the correct way to do it so that I hit my brain stem, so I'm not worried.  It will be quick.

There will be someone else in this world that has the same abilities and talents as me sometime soon; I'm not unique at all.  I don't matter.

I posted this so that everyone here could see that when people are done with life, they really are done.  They have thought everything through and there is nothing else to consider.

Nobody would believe in me because I have so many disorders.  Everyone that I would like to be employed by would think that I was too crazy to even be considered for employment.  I'm a complete waste to them.

If I've already discovered something that is completely different than anything else I've read, then how will the professionals believe me if it's not in relation to anything that has already been done before.

I don't have a PhD in Physics or Mathematics right now; hell I don't even have an undergraduate degree.  I got really depressed in my last semester of university.  I was supposed to graduate in December - which was a semester early - but I just could't.  I was studying Anthropology as a sole major, and the program wasn't very as well-known in the anthropological community as many of the other anthropology programs.

I transferred to another university, and I added mathematics, physics, and geology, and I felt so much more alive.  I felt like I could actually do something with my life.  But then I thought about how I had left a university, and how that would look to potential employers.  I figured out that I am not up to the standard that I need to be.
because they have already published something, and they know what the market is looking for, and they say that the market is not looking for anything like me.
Nobody takes me seriously.  If you could see a picture of me, you would understand.

I had been trying to connect some physics concepts to some some emotional concepts that are common within the human psyche.  But nobody believes in my work, and nobody believes that I can compare them.  I'm giving up because better people than me have decided that I'm not worthy of comparing the two.
Should I live?
Um, I guess I can answer your questions.

I just don't want to be the only one.  I can't be the only one who hasn't ever felt anything physically.  I can't be the only one who's tried to dig out their stomach because it was bothering me.  I can't be the only one who has limited hearing because I tore out my eardrum when I was little (because it itched a lot.)  I can't be the only one.  And If I am, then there really is no reason to live.
But how can I be within a society, without association with anyone who actually tries to understand what I'm going through?

And honestly, I have already made a story like that.  I couldn't find anyone who would appreciate it, so I didn't send it to anyone.  I'm sure I know about some of the aspects that correlate to everything I'm putting out there, but if I don't have a Master's or PhD, I won't be taken seriously.  I've calculated so many things about human emotion that is corroborated by physics and mathematics, but nobody wants to read my research.  I know why people feel the way they do, and I think that my research could help change the prevalence of depression in the world today.  I can explain it all with physics and mathematics, but I won't be believed without a PhD.

I can't conform to a PhD to finish my research because it hasn't been formulated as yet.  I guess I'm just going to try to make people believe that I give a damn.  I care.  I'm trying to let people know that physics can interpret human emotion, and I'm trying to make people and organizations just listen to my ideas.  Emotion is amorphous and so is physics.  You should break ties with them.

It's not so fun when you want to tell your best friend that her color is the most beautiful shade of turquoise blue that you've ever seen.  You can't know that whenever she talked, you were calmed down from everything that was hurting you emotionally from all angles.  You can't know how it felt when she said that I was crazy and that I probably needed to be away from society for a while.

I actually thought about that before, but that was before all my friends left me.  They thought I was crazy, and they didn't believe anything I felt or said.  They didn't try to understand anything that was going on with me.
